_: The colour regions of each drawn creature (docs/mount-colours.md 2.6), as rules over a colour's hue (degrees), saturation and value (0..1): the first region whose rule matches wins, in the order written; a colour no rule matches is Coat. tools/skins/skin_colors.py applies them to the pictures (front/ included) and writes each skin's [Colors]. Edit here, never in the script.

dragon._: Coat = the red scales and the wing; Muzzle = the golden belly (its own row on the page, Second tone: the user wants to tweak it apart from the scales, 2026-10-20); Dark = outlines, horns and back spikes (bone); Eye = the yellow eye. Dark first (the bone's low-saturation golds), then Eye (the yellow and its highlight, which the belly's hue range would also take), then Muzzle.

rat._: Coat = the grey fur; Muzzle = the pink tail, ears and nose; Dark = outlines; Eye = the red eye.

snail._: Coat = the green body; Muzzle = the brown shell; Dark = the outline.

worm._: Coat = the pink skin; Dark = the outline.

gerry._: The game's skull, read at run time: its colours come from the in-game export (BepInEx/GK2-asset-probe/game-skins/gerry, the Mounts tab's Export button); Dark = the sockets and cracks, the bone is Coat.
